newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens looking for defence partner.
newsitem.headline: Siemens looking for defence partner.

text.p: German giant Siemens AG said on Friday it was talking to several possible partners for its defence electronics unit.

"There are no concrete negotiations but we are talking to several different partners," Siemens spokesman Thomas Weber told Reuters. "In this field, wea all have the same problem with declining defence spending and everyone is talking to everyone."

Weber declined to name the companies Siemens has talked to so far but said there are a half dozen or more possible candidates. "We are looking for a partner that has defence electronics as a core business," he said.
Siemens would consider a joint venture or even a sale of its unit, he said.
Weber confirmed that the company has sent letters to employees at its Siemens Plessey unit informing them that the company was looking for a partner to improve competitiveness.

Siemens Plessey, which has most of its employees in Britain, suffered a setback earlier this month when the UK Ministry of Defence cancelled an order for electronic warfare systems after the company spent 50 million pounds ($81.3 million) on development.
